inputs.description: Generated blueprint; no operator data required

summary.headline: Start the Sales AI at Assist-only; gate every customer-facing send behind approval and every forecast-affecting write behind an audit trail and human sign-off.
summary.narrative: This blueprint tiers what an AI may do in Sales. Assist (read-only) is the safe first step. Acting splits into customer-facing sends, which require human approval and respect consent/CAN-SPAM/GDPR and never commit price or terms, and forecast-affecting writes, which require full auditability and human-in-the-loop. The suite never deploys an agent — a human implements and owns these controls.

findings.title: Tier 1 — Assist (read-only): the safe first step
findings.what_we_found: Read-only assistance — summarising deals, drafting text for a human to use, surfacing risks, and answering questions over CRM data — carries no write or send risk.
findings.why_it_blocks_ai: Nothing blocks this tier once readiness gaps are closed; starting anywhere higher exposes the org to send and forecast risk before controls exist.
the_fix: Scope the AI to read-only outputs first: summaries, drafts, risk flags.
Confirm pipeline, capture, and definition readiness before graduating any capability.
Keep every output clearly labelled as a draft a human owns.

findings.title: Tier 2a — Customer-facing sends: behind human approval
findings.what_we_found: Any AI action that could reach a prospect or customer — emails, sequence steps, meeting scheduling — must not send autonomously.
findings.why_it_blocks_ai: Unapproved sends create consent, deliverability, and brand exposure, and an AI committing price or terms could create unintended obligations.
the_fix: Require explicit human approval before any AI-drafted message is sent.
Respect consent and CAN-SPAM / GDPR: lawful basis, working unsubscribe, accurate sender identity.
Hard-rule the AI out of committing price, discounts, or contractual terms.

findings.title: Tier 2b — Forecast-affecting writes: auditable, human-in-the-loop
findings.what_we_found: Writes that change reported numbers — stage, amount, close date, forecast category — directly move the forecast.
findings.why_it_blocks_ai: Silent or unreviewed AI writes to forecast fields would corrupt reporting and remove accountability for the numbers leadership commits to.
the_fix: Require a full audit trail on every AI write: who/what/when/why, and reversible.
Keep a human in the loop to confirm each forecast-affecting change before it lands.
Block AI self-promotion between tiers — tier changes are a human governance decision.
